sql: with p as (  select split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) ser, split_part(market_ticker,'-',2) ev, market_ticker t, strategy, quantity q, pnl, assumed_price px, created_at  from paper_trades  where split_part(market_ticker,'-',1) in ('KXNFLTOTAL','KXITFMATCH','KXITFWMATCH') and status in ('settled','closed_sl')    and strategy ilike '%mmsell%' and pnl is not null and quantity>0 and assumed_price>=90    and (split_part(market_ticker,'-',1)<>'KXNFLTOTAL' or created_at>='2026-09-09')), g as (select ser, strategy, ev, sum(pnl) gp from p group by 1,2,3) select p.ser, p.strategy, count(*) trades, count(distinct t) mkts, sum(q) qty, round(100*sum(pnl)/sum(q),2) c_per_ct,  sum(case when pnl<0 then 1 else 0 end) n_lost, round(sum(pnl),2) net,  (select count(*) from g where g.ser=p.ser and g.strategy=p.strategy) games,  (select round((avg(gp)/nullif(stddev_samp(gp)/sqrt(count(*)),0))::numeric,2) from g where g.ser=p.ser and g.strategy=p.strategy) z_game from p group by 1,2 having count(*)>=10 order by 1, 6 desc
